name: El Rosario (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, white at the hoist and green at the fly, charged with the crowned arms of El Rosario (roses, a pine and an anchor).
history: The flag of the municipality was approved by the Government of the Canary Islands on 13 August 1999 as a rectangular cloth of silk, taffeta, satin, wool or synthetic fibre whose length is one and a half times its width, composed of two right triangles, white the one at the hoist and green the one at the fly.
